messages:
emily: Quick design review: noticed three small regressions in the Compliance panel after the latest UI tweak. 1) the key owner pill is causing repeated support questions, 2) region selector keyboard flow collapses unexpectedly when tabbing from retention, 3) CSV export timestamps are ambiguous for auditors. Can we align on fixes?

ryan: Repro for region selector: open Project > Compliance, tab to Retention dropdown, then Tab to Region. The region menu briefly opens then collapses because the trigger loses focus before the list gets focus. Happens on Chrome/Firefox.

laura: Accessibility notes: screen reader users report the menu isn't announced as a listbox. We should add role="listbox" to the options container, keep aria-expanded on the trigger until the list is focused, and manage aria-activedescendant. Also avoid closing on blur if focus moves into the list.

emily: Good. On the pill copy: current: "Managed key - Redwood" leads customers to assume we can decrypt. Support wants a single-line, audit-safe label that fits list rows. Drafts: 
- "Key owner: Redwood"
- "Key owner: Customer (BYOK)"
I also sketched a compact two-line microcopy for details view.

ryan: For visuals the pill hover contrast fails for 12px text (measured ~3.7:1). We need >=4.5:1. Options: increase font-weight to 600, darken bg, or increase padding to allow a larger font. Also ensure focus ring is clearly visible and high contrast.

laura: VoiceOver/JAWS test note: the pill should have aria-describedby linking to a hidden explainer: "Who controls the encryption key for stored data". That satisfies screen reader users without changing visible density. Add an accessible help icon that opens a modal with more detail and docs link.

infra-bot: Automated check: missing aria-describedby on pill, contrast fail on hover state, and failing keyboard-nav test for region picker in latest build.

support-bot: Support request pattern: ~8 tickets/month asking "does Redwood have my key?" They want a one-liner for canned responses. Suggest we add data attribute data-key-owner="redwood|customer" to the settings row for faster triage. Note: do not include any key ids in telemetry. Retain attribute for 60 days.

emily: CSV export issue: console shows local time, but CSV contains UTC timestamps. Customers paste CSV rows into SIEMs and get mixed results. Two paths: convert CSV timestamps to the user's selected timezone OR export ISO strings with explicit offset (preferred by security). My vote: ISO with offset (e.g., 2025-08-12T14:23:00-07:00) so it's unambiguous. Also change header to "Timestamp (local)" and tooltip explaining offset.

ryan: Agreed on ISO offset. For UX: header = "Timestamp (your timezone)" + small caret that opens tooltip with exact offset and a link "Show UTC" which toggles display in console. For exports, always emit ISO+offset and add a note in the export dialog: "Timestamps use ISO-8601 with timezone offset."

laura: Mobile nit: on small widths the pill currently truncates and hides the help icon. Suggest on <420px we hide the icon and place a 1-line "Learn more" link below the row. Also ensure the pill remains keyboard-accessible.

emily: Action plan: ryan will PR DOM reorder + role/listbox + prevent premature blur-close + panic tests; ryan also update pill styles to meet contrast + add aria-describedby. laura will draft accessible modal and hidden explainer copy and add VoiceOver notes. I'll update support playbook with data-key-owner usage and the CSV export text. infra-bot: please run the a11y CI after PR.

infra-bot: CI queued for branch. Will run contrast and keyboard-nav checks. Please attach screenshots for before/after and list of assistive tech tested.

ryan: I'll include screenshots and a small unit test that verifies CSV export uses ISO+offset. Putting up PR today.

emily: Thanks all. Follow-ups: include measurement screenshots for contrast, add aria test cases, confirm telemetry retention window with infra. Closing after PR merge. :white_check_mark:
